Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: An interactive date or hangout proposal shared between a sender and receiver across devices.

senderName.description: Display name of the sender who created the proposal.

receiverName.description: Display name of the receiver invited by the proposal.

outingTopic.description: Custom outing type or invitation title set by the sender (e.g. Date, Hangout, Movie, Dinner, or custom text).

treatPayer.description: Which person the sender selected to end up treating (receiver or sender).

pin.description: 4-digit private PIN protecting the sender dashboard.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the proposal.

noDodges.description: Number of times the receiver tried to tap or hover the dodging No button.

treatClicks.description: Number of times the receiver tapped the shrinking treat card.

day.description: Chosen day for the date or outing.

time.description: Chosen time for the date or outing.

location.description: Typed location or meeting spot chosen by the receiver.

plan.description: Chosen or custom plan for the date or outing.

treatChoice.description: Final treat choice confirmed by the receiver.

letter.description: Generated keepsake letter from the sender's point of view.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the proposal was created.

/proposals/{proposalId}.description: Shared proposal documents accessed via unique proposalId in the link.
